Definition: from G4012 and G3611; to reside around, i.e. be a neighbor:--dwell round about.
BiblicalUsage: Perioikeo means to dwell round about, to be a neighbour. When John the Baptist was born, fear came on all that dwelt round about, and his sayings were noised abroad through the hill country of Judaea.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that a birth can shake a neighbourhood: the hill country heard, and fear came on all who dwelt round about.
RelatedPeople: Elizabeth; Zechariah, Father of John the Baptist
RelatedEvents: The Birth of John the Baptist
